name: calc_present_value
description:
Present value of a single future amount with annual compounding: PV = FV / (1 + r)^t. Computed locally in Python; no API key or network.
Returns {future_value, rate, years, present_value}, present_value rounded to 2 decimals.
Inputs (* required): future_value* (amount), rate* (annual discount rate in percent), years* (may be fractional).
For a series of cash flows use calc_npv; the inverse is calc_future_value.
Example: {"future_value": 50000, "rate": 6, "years": 8}
